title: Added Ando: agent-native team messenger, $20M seed
summary: Slack-alternative where AI agents are workspace members with identities and permissions; direct overlap with Teamily's human+agent group chat for small teams.

title: Ando emerges from stealth with $20M from Accel, Index, Emergence
summary: Well-funded new entrant on the same ICP, currently waitlist-only; expect fast competition for agent-in-chat positioning.

title: Manus launches Cue, personal agents with group chats, alongside Manus 2.0
summary: Cue agents get their own email, phone and wallet and can share group chats to split work; early access via invite code, directly overlaps our agents-in-group-chat pitch.

title: Manus reportedly raises $500M+ led by Boyu and IDG
summary: Large round (single outlet, status vs Meta unclear) gives Manus resources to push Cue and team features.

title: Google previews Gemini agent for work: team agents with own Workspace accounts
summary: Team agents with their own Workspace identity can be added to group chats and shared tasks (private preview, no price); platform move into our agent-as-teammate space.

title: Slack Enterprise+ public price replaced by 'Contact sales'
summary: Tracker shows $45/user/month listing removed on Oct 13; cause unconfirmed, affects enterprise not small teams.

title: Copilot Studio enhancements for Copilot Chat agents GA Oct 26
summary: Connected agents, topics and evaluations arrive in Copilot Chat agents, strengthening multi-agent workflows inside Microsoft 365.
